lead: A calm daily scan of New Orleans with 36 fresh links across news, dining, entertainment, music, and 12 event picks, plus the latest local forecast.

current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Partly cloudy. Low around 75, with temperatures rising to around 77 overnight. Southeast wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms likely after 8am. Mostly cloudy. High near 86, with temperatures falling to around 83 in the afternoon. Southeast wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 60%. New rainfall amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Showers And Thunderstorms Likely then Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms likely before 7am, then showers and thunderstorms. Cloudy, with a high near 83. Northwest wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Memorial Day
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms before 1pm, then showers and thunderstorms likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 83. South wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Tuesday

seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 7am, then showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 84. Southeast wind 5 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
